title: Francois - Act 1 Boss Guide (Location, Weakness & How to Beat)
description: Francois in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - where to find it, its elemental weakness and resistances, and how to beat it. Act 1, Esquie's Nest.

facts.label: Key Drops
facts.value: Colour of Lumina · Resplendent Chroma Catalyst

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Francois is a shielded turtle boss fought at Esquie's Nest, and he is the first fight that punishes you for ignoring an elemental key. His ice beam is a one-shot at the level you meet him if you fail to dodge or parry.

sections.title: Where to Find the Francois
sections.content: Location: Esquie's Nest, reached during Act 1 after the Flying Waters. The Nest is part of the main path, so Francois is mandatory.

Dark is Francois's only weakness, and in a first playthrough your Dark options are thin. Magic damage from Lune's Dark skills or a Dark-infused weapon will do most of the work.

sections.title: How to Beat the Francois
sections.content:
Francois does not move - he is locked in place - so the entire fight is about surviving his ranged pressure while you chew through shields.

Shields are the real health bar

Francois stacks multiple shield instances that soak damage before his health moves. Multi-hit skills and Break effects are worth far more here than one big hit, because a single large attack is wasted on a single shield layer.

The ice beam

His beam is the kill move. It is telegraphed clearly before it fires and it will delete a character who stands still. Parry or dodge it and the rest of the fight is straightforward; miss it twice and you lose the run.

  • Bring Dark damage - it is the only element that lands cleanly.
  • Prefer multi-hit skills to strip shields.
  • Treat the beam as the only attack that matters for timing practice.
